coinbase_q3_2026.circle_arrangement: Coinbase states that it renewed its arrangement with Circle on the same terms in 2026.
coinbase_q3_2026.presentation_correction: During Q1 2026 Coinbase moved revenue earned on corporate payment-stablecoin balances from Stablecoin revenue to Other revenue; the reclassification has no impact on total revenue.
coinbase_q3_2026.usdc_balance_statement: Coinbase says average USDC held in Coinbase products reached an all-time high; the 10-Q does not provide the exact $22B figure in the cited passage.
coinbase_q3_2026.interpretation: The reported $306.905M is Coinbase's stablecoin revenue line, not XRP revenue and not a direct measure of Circle's distribution expense.

circle_q3_2026.interpretation: Circle explicitly describes these as distribution costs in connection with its agreements with Coinbase. The amount is not Coinbase revenue or a standalone profit-sharing amount.

accounting_boundary.rule: Do not subtract or net Coinbase stablecoin revenue against Circle Coinbase-related distribution costs.
accounting_boundary.reason: They are separate entities' accounting line items with different definitions, recognition, presentation and period context. Coinbase also reclassified corporate payment-stablecoin-balance revenue to Other revenue.
accounting_boundary.prohibited_inference: The arithmetic difference is not a verified bilateral profit, margin, or cash transfer.

sbi_vc_trade_rlusd.legal_entity: SBI VC Trade Co., Ltd. is a consolidated subsidiary of SBI Holdings, Inc.; it is the VCTRADE service operator named in SBI's RLUSD launch materials.
sbi_vc_trade_rlusd.japan_launch: SBI VC Trade began handling RLUSD on 2026-06-24 as a Japanese-law Type 4 Electronic Payment Instrument.
sbi_vc_trade_rlusd.current_network: SBI VC Trade's current VCTRADE network-support FAQ lists RLUSD on Ethereum only.
sbi_vc_trade_rlusd.future_network: SBI VC Trade's July 15, 2026 official RLUSD explainer says it began with Ethereum and would expand supported chains sequentially. This does not establish XRPL support as live.
sbi_vc_trade_rlusd.interpretation: The SBI/Ripple distribution relationship is live, but current VCTRADE RLUSD transfer support is Ethereum-only in the inspected official network list. Do not infer SBI-hosted RLUSD settlement on XRPL or XRP demand.

future_at_announcement: RLUSD collateral use on Coinbase Global Exchange
coinbase_ripple_rlusd.interpretation: Coinbase's live RLUSD support spans XRPL, Base and Ethereum, but the Global Exchange collateral use case was explicitly future at launch.

bny_ripple.live_or_announced_current_capability: BNY says it now supports XRP and RLUSD on its Digital Asset Custody platform for eligible clients.
future_or_exploratory: Tokenized trade-finance workflows with Ripple and C2FO
bny_ripple.conditions: Ripple's announcement subjects future plans to client requirements and applicable regulatory approvals.
bny_ripple.interpretation: Custody capability is not a disclosed balance, actual XRP purchase, settlement throughput or collateral utilization.

expected_later_2026: RLUSD availability in the Robinhood app
robinhood_ripple.announced_xrpl_use: Robinhood says it will leverage RLUSD on XRPL for institutional settlement.
related_rails: Ripple Treasury integration for Robinhood treasury operations
Ripple Prime financing and market-access relationship with Bitstamp by Robinhood
robinhood_ripple.interpretation: This is a material announced distribution and institutional-rail relationship. The release does not disclose completed XRPL settlement volumes, XRP bridge-asset usage, balances or XRP purchases.

groupings.relationship: Two separate issuer filings describing the same bilateral arrangement; not independent confirmation of the underlying economic relationship.
Three Ripple-issued announcements; distinct partners but common issuer source.
Two first-party SBI VC Trade pages; the FAQ is the current network-support list and the July explainer provides the stated rollout sequence.

disagreements_and_limitations: Ripple and SBI announcements describe the Japanese RLUSD launch but do not by themselves establish the currently supported transfer chain; the current SBI VCTRADE FAQ lists Ethereum.
Coinbase's launch announcement supports XRPL, Base and Ethereum but explicitly defers Global Exchange collateral availability.
BNY and Robinhood announcements describe current capabilities and intended future uses; no transaction-volume or XRP-balance data is disclosed.

model_admission.reason: These are dated corporate/accounting/network-status observations, not synchronized XRP market or executable-flow features. They can populate an event timeline after point-in-time ingestion and source-eligibility validation, but cannot be treated as XRP demand or price predictors by themselves.
